name: streaks
description: Shows your consecutive days of coding with Claude in the status line.

persistent.title: Keep it in the status line
persistent.description: Leave the streak in the status line all session. Off: it shows for 10 seconds at the start of a session, then goes.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: Comma-separated streak lengths, in days, that get a toast when you reach them.
